`git status --short` / `git diff --stat` show a broad in-progress refactor across layout, protocol, and canvas/agent plugins. Two concept swaps stand out in the requested dirs:

**apps/web/src/lib/client/layout**: "window" → "dock". `windows.ts` (MIN_WINDOW_WIDTH/HEIGHT) deleted, replaced by `docks.ts` (MIN_DOCK_WIDTH/HEIGHT). `frames.ts` deleted, replaced by `tree.ts` — same split/leaf-tree logic (leafNode, insertAtEdge, layoutTree, dropEdge, etc.) just renamed and repointed to import from `./docks` instead of `./windows`. Components follow: `PaneWindow.svelte`/`PaneNodeView.svelte` deleted, new `PaneDockView.svelte`/`PaneTreeView.svelte` added. `SessionHeader.svelte` also deleted (folded elsewhere).

**packages/protocol/src**: old canvas/session schema (`assets.ts`, `blobs.ts`, `project.ts`, `schema.ts` — Asset, Project, StoredObject, BlobStore, ProjectStore types) removed entirely. New `agent-control.ts` added, exporting spawn/list/read/stop-agent tool schemas and MCP tool naming — this is the cross-harness agent-spawning feature. `session-view.ts` gained `sessionDigest`/`messageText`/`SessionDigest`/`DigestMessage`.

Net effect: legacy per-project asset/blob storage model dropped in favor of an agent-control protocol layer, alongside a window→dock rename in the pane layout tree. Consistent with `plugins/gauntlet-loop` being deleted wholesale in the same diff. No files edited.
